_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: Using since for a length of time (I live here since two years)
mistake.vi: Dùng since cho khoảng thời gian: "I live here since two years" (tiếng Đức: seit zwei Jahren)

hook.bad: I live here since two years
hook.good: I have lived here for two years

segments.text: Don't say, I live here since two years. Say, I have lived here for two years.
For a length of time, use for. Use since only for a start, like since Monday.
Repeat after me. I have lived here for two years.
Great job! Now say it about you.

native.caption: Im Deutschen sagt man “seit zwei Jahren”, aber im Englischen steht bei einer Zeitspanne “for”: “I have lived here for two years”. Für den Startpunkt, zum Beispiel seit Montag, nimmt man “since”. Sprich Ama nach und übe Grammatik in der Lexkite-App.

en.caption: In German you say “seit zwei Jahren”, but in English a length of time takes “for”: “I have lived here for two years”. For a starting point, like Monday, use “since”. Repeat after Ama and practice grammar in the Lexkite app.
